name: Backstageplay Inc.
summary: Backstageplay, Inc. engages in the provision of internet entertainment and marketing solutions. The firm focuses on the development of social gaming white label platforms in the music industry. Its product allows artists to connect with their fans by rewarding participation and game-play activity through virtual goods and rewards. The company was founded by Scott Fulton White on October 18, 2004 and is headquartered in Vancouver, Canada.
